# Week 13 - Statistical Modeling and Quarto

## Import Data

Import data from week11 ecv_by_specimen.csv and print the dimensions and first five rows. 

```{python}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import patsy
from plotnine import *

ecv = pd.read_csv('fossils_ecv.csv')

# Put the grades in evolutionary order (otherwise they sort alphabetically)
grade_order = ['archaic', 'mega', 'trans', 'pre.mod']
ecv['grade'] = pd.Categorical(ecv['grade'], categories=grade_order, ordered=True)

print(ecv.shape)
print('Missing grades:', ecv['grade'].isna().sum())
ecv.head()
```
